title: Whereabouts of the Dark Photograph
notes: case_type: theft (no murder). Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan/Shin'ichi, Ai Haibara, Professor Agasa, Heiji Hattori, Ran) omitted by convention; their deductions are represented as direct edges among the actual involved parties instead. `label.murderer_id` is kept as the schema's fixed field name but here denotes the principal culprit of the theft, Tago. The old cases/ file had the culprit (Tago), core objects, and both clues essentially right -- no reversal found here, unlike some other rebuilds. Its main gap was scope: it modeled only the theft's suspect pool with generic 'knows' edges and omitted the entire A-plot this two-parter is actually built around -- the search for the identity of Hondou Eisuke's black-organization-linked father via an old photograph, which is why the theft happens at all (the photo album Tago grabbed to hide his own fraud happened to also hold the photo Conan/Heiji were chasing). That backstory arc (Hondou Eisuke, his father's aliases, Mizunashi Rena, Nishigun's late grandfather) has been added as backstory_figure nodes per the 'every named person who matters' rule. No 'order'/'temporal_frame'/'years_before_present' fields per current build guidance.

clues.desc: Toilet slippers are the only ones neatly arranged while every entryway slipper sits scattered -- someone besides Nishigun used the toilet after he left for work.
Undried sweat droplets and damp tissues sit in a shut, un-cooled room, and the computer's CPU is already hot though just switched on -- together they place an intruder here under 10 minutes ago.

No bare footprints mark the floor and the culprit's own slippers are missing, yet the slippers Nishigun is currently wearing -- not the entryway pair -- are the warm, sweat-soaked ones: the culprit is still barefoot and hiding close by right now.
Of the three key-holders (Saori ~150cm and heavy, Tago shorter still, Furushou 180cm+ and thin), only someone short enough to need the chair as a footstool could also fold into the washing machine.

Saori's call carried no ambient room sound and Furushou's request would have exposed a hiding spot by getting the apartment cleaned -- only Tago's requests, finish the models overnight, open the window, do the wash at dawn, fit someone trapped silently on the veranda side needing Nishigun to unknowingly set them free.

edges.motive_type: cover_up_of_fraud (feared the relabeled tank model would expose him as a liar to friends and Nishigun's blog readers)

edges.detail: grandfather's dying request to hand the photo/album on to the regular customer it concerns
